# Overseer overhaul (open season): recalibrate signals, fix model/lifecycle/authority, close coverage gaps, clean up — and rethink the subsystem from first principles

## Problem

**The overseer doesn't work, and this ticket is open season on fixing it.** Across recent runs it is simultaneously *too loud* (a constant stream of false alarms operators learn to ignore) and *useless at the moment of need* (real deadlocks surface as a generic `stuck-phase-transition` or nothing at all). The live `EGG_EVENT_LOOP_OWNER=orchestrator` proving run of #3064 (pipeline `issue-3200`, 2026-06-25) made the failure modes concrete and reproducible — its entire overseer alert stream was false positives, and the overseer burned its respawn budget fighting its own bootstrap.

This is the **overseer-overhaul umbrella** — reinstated 2026-06-10 and still live; do **not** re-close as stale. #3051 is a tactical authority slice *of* this work, not a replacement for it.

## How to read this ticket

This ticket has **two layers, and both are in scope:**

1. **The concrete findings below are real and meant to be addressed.** §1–§6 are evidence-backed defects (the Sonnet self-injection loop, the alert-reflection vector, the false stall alerts, the respawn churn, the missing authority) plus a surveyed coverage-gap list and cleanup debt. They remain the known starting work.
2. **On top of that, this is open season.** Beyond the listed items, question every aspect of how the overseer is built and propose better ideas — including ones not listed. Question the fundamentals (is a respawning watcher pod the right shape? should overseership be orchestrator-side evaluation over the event stream instead of an agent?). Net-negative-in-lines is a feature — a good chunk of the win is likely deletion.

The existing findings are **commitments**; the open-season invitation is **expansion** — broadening the aperture must not defer the specifics.

## 1. The model is wrong — stop running the overseer on Sonnet

`overseer_decision_maker_model` defaults to `"sonnet"` (`orchestrator/models.py:725`). Sonnet mis-classifies its own legitimate bootstrap as a prompt-injection attack — refuses, exits, gets respawned, and broadcasts `[high]` security-flavored alerts each cycle. **Fix:** run the overseer's decision tier on Opus (fleet standard); keep cost low by tiering (classification stays on Haiku, routine corrective decisions on Sonnet, only adversarial/high-stakes escalate to Opus) via per-role model config, not the bespoke field. Route through `resolve_agent_model` and deprecate `overseer_decision_maker_model` (folds #2813: `spawn_overseer_job` ~kubernetes_spawner.py:2767 hands `decision_model` straight to the builder, never consulting the per-agent resolver).

## 1.5 Run it like every other agent — no special case

The overseer must run through the same sandbox image and the same spawn/entrypoint path as every other agent — just a particular agent with different permissions and a different prompt. Fold `spawn_overseer_job` into `spawn_agent_job(agent_role=OVERSEER, …)`. The bundled `overseer_monitor.py` + "trust-and-run a baked-in script" bootstrap is the direct cause of the §1 self-injection loop — whatever monitoring the overseer needs should arrive via tools/MCP/prompt. Bespoke flags (`EGG_OVERSEER_MODE`, `EGG_OVERSEER_DECISION_MODEL`, `_check_and_respawn_overseer`) are symptoms of the special-case shape. Hard constraint: if the overseer remains an agent, it is a normal agent — no parallel plumbing.

## 2. Trustworthy signals — the overseer cries wolf (calibration is deliverable #1)

Catalogue: the self-injection loop (model-driven); its own `OVERSEER_ALERT`s reflected back into agents as "operator directives" via the mid-turn injection PostToolUse hook (`shared/egg_agent/client.py:614` → `midturn_messages.py`) — these are agent-bus broadcasts, NOT operator HITL directives, and the injection path should not surface them as operator messages; false stall alerts from the #3230 observability gap (event-loop-spawned pods aren't in the running-agent set → "0 running agents" fires `phase stalled` while the producer is actively drafting) — make the stall detector lifecycle-owner-aware; heartbeat-stall false positive on plan producers mid-drafting (#2242); branch-divergence false positive (#2222/#2224 flags `(#NNNN)` subjects as merged-main contamination — the real test is ancestor-of-origin/main / patch-id match, not subject pattern matching); prior incidents (#2948 transient kubelet eviction misread as producer-permanent-death cascading to FAILED). **Deliverable:** calibrate detection against this known-normal/known-bad corpus as an explicit, tested deliverable; add #2059/#2132 thrashing/spinning/improper-tool-use definitions.

## 3. Lifecycle — respawn churn now, settle against #3064

Respawn churn / cost bleed (overseer respawned every ~90s exit 0 for the entire run, including multi-hour HITL parks with no agents running — violates "no overseer during HITL waits with no agents running"); `_check_and_respawn_overseer` (`pipelines.py` ~433-596) is overseer-specific machinery with no phase-agent analog — fold into agent-restart machinery. Settle the phase-peer model against #3064 (merged): under orchestrator-owned on-demand spawning there is no long-lived phase cohort; the successor shape is plausibly orchestrator-side evaluation over the event stream. Restart/generation hygiene: clear per-agent escalation history on restart; add a generation token reset on orchestrator pod recycle. Redeploy interaction (#3233).

## 4. Authority to act (#3051 — make it structural)

Alerts are informational only; `register_open_question` is 403-denied (`roles.py:can_modify`), so a confirmed deadlock can't open an operator HITL. Make it structural: an authorized control-plane path to open operator HITLs + a small bounded corrective vocabulary (nudge, cohort respawn).

## 5. Signal-coverage gaps (survey — verify & extend)

Current Tier-1: `container_liveness`, `startup_state`, `phase_output`, `state_consistency`, `consensus_stall`, `incomplete_consensus_stall`; Tier-2: `agent_inspector`. Gaps by layer: orchestrator runtime (`_run_pipeline` thread liveness #2234/#3233, auto-advance wedge → Tier-1 #2219, approved-decision-orphaned, duration drift, agent-restart propagation deadline, restarted-decision replay); worktree & branch (git-history sanity with corrected ancestor/patch-id test, corruption/lock anomalies, disk/inode pressure); container & k8s (funnel pod transitions through overseer #2210, repeated same-role restarts, OOMKilled/evicted #2948); gateway (error-rate spikes, repeated identical denials, token-expiry); BRC/thrashing (reviewer/producer thrash, late CONFIRMED then re-NACK, cap unbounded incomplete-consensus deferral); HITL/decision queue; cost/budget (token-cost anomaly, `max_llm_cost_per_hour`, fix incomplete cost tracking in self_monitor.py); overseer self-health (classifier/advisor failure-rate, wire OverseerSelfMonitor into alert path); external state (PR-state drift `pr_external_mutation`, pushed-but-PR-not-updated); LLM substrate (LiteLLM-proxy reachability #2769, effective-model drift, sustained Anthropic 5xx).

## 6. Cleanup (net-negative in lines)

Delete dead code (`orchestrator/overseer/issue_filer.py` preserved-but-unused #1962 — confirm no imports); collapse per-class fail-soft scaffolding; de-duplicate advisor-escalation plumbing; harden two-tier file_issue dedup. `monitor.py` (~2,050 lines) decomposition rides #2817 — don't re-decompose here. Each new alert class gets a paste-ready `issue_template.py` entry; shadow → enforce for `overseer_auto_file_issues_mode` once telemetry validates the gate.

## Cross-references

#3051 (authority/recovery, tactical slice), #3064 (merged, orchestrator-owned spawning), #3230 (event-loop observability gap → false stall alerts), #3233 (redeploy strands AWAITING_HUMAN), #2813 (route overseer model via resolve_agent_model — folded §1), #2059/#2132 (thrashing/spinning defs — folded §2), #2222/#2224 (branch-divergence detector), #2817 (monitor.py decomposition), #2272/#2111 (closed — internal architecture, folded here).
